title: Securities Trading Policy

tiers.name: KMP
tiers.description: Persons having authority and responsibility for planning, directing and controlling the Company's activities, including any director (executive or otherwise), CEO, CFO or company secretary, as determined under AASB 124. Subject to Closed Periods, prior clearance to deal, a margin lending/similar-arrangement clearance regime, an absolute ban on derivatives, and a hedging/short-sale/short-term dealing ban.

tiers.name: Employee
tiers.description: Any employee or consultant of the Company who is not KMP. Subject only to the general prohibition on dealing while in possession of Inside Information; not subject to Closed Periods, prior clearance, margin lending clearance, or the hedging/short-sale/short-term dealing ban.

windows.start_anchor: 10 Business Days before the expected release of announcements regarding material exploration results, mineral resource/reserve estimates, material technical study results, sales/production figures, profit/production forecasts, material borrowings, material liquidity/cash flow changes, significant operational changes, significant litigation, significant mergers/acquisitions/takeovers, major asset purchases/sales, material new products/technology, or capital raisings by the Company (except a KMP's own participation in the raising)
windows.end_anchor: 2 hours after the actual release of the relevant announcement

windows.start_anchor: 5 Business Days before the expected release of quarterly activity reports, quarterly cash flow statements, half year or full year financial results, a disclosure document containing Inside Information, a takeover target statement, a bidder's statement, or a scheme booklet
windows.end_anchor: 2 hours after the actual release of the relevant document

rules.detail: Absolute, always-on ban on any financial product created over or in respect of the Company's securities for KMP, independent of Closed Periods or clearance; only carved out for options over unissued capital granted by the Company itself, which does not assist a bank-written OTC collar.
rules.evidence: KMP are prohibited at all times from Dealing in financial products issued or created over or in respect of the Company's Securities. For the avoidance of doubt this clause does not apply to an option over unissued capital granted by the Company.

rules.detail: Company Securities is expressly defined to include financial products issued or created over the Company's securities; non-KMP Employees may deal in such products provided they do not possess Inside Information, and are not subject to Closed Periods or clearance.
rules.evidence: An Employee (who is not a KMP) may Deal in Company Securities or the Securities of a Transaction Entity if he or she does not have information that he or she knows, or ought reasonably to know, is Inside Information

clearance.approver: Chief Executive Officer (for non-director KMP); Chairman of the Board (for directors other than the Chairman); any other two Directors (for the Chairman)
clearance.evidence: At least 2 Business Days prior to when a KMP intends to Deal in Company Securities, the KMP must first inform the Approving Officer (and at the same time the Company Secretary) by submitting a securities trading request... written requests and clearances may include facsimiles and emails and are valid for a period the earlier of: (a) 5 Business Days; (b) the Business Day before the Company enters a Closed Period; and (c) the time that the KMP comes into possession of Inside Information.

At least 10 Business Days prior to a KMP entering into any margin lending or similar arrangement, the KMP must first seek approval from the Approving Officer to enter into the margin lending or similar arrangement. The KMP must provide a copy of all documents relating to the margin lending arrangements for review by the Approving Officer.

exemption_authority: The Approving Officer may give clearance during a Closed Period for a KMP to sell (not buy) in Exceptional Circumstances (severe financial hardship, court order/family settlement, or other overriding legal/regulatory requirement), but never if Inside Information exists (subject to a lawful obligation such as a court order); the Board may separately treat an unforeseen circumstance as exceptional if consistent with the Policy's objectives.
jurisdiction_overlays: U.S. securities law requirements and market best practices regarding insider trading liabilities were considered in drafting this Policy (clause 1.3(e)), though no specific US rules are detailed.

bespoke_clauses.clause: KMP are prohibited at all times from Dealing in financial products issued or created over or in respect of the Company's Securities.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: This is an unconditional, closed-period-independent ban on any derivative over the Company's securities for KMP, with no clearance carve-out anywhere in the Policy, so a funded collar's put and call legs cannot lawfully be entered by a KMP.

bespoke_clauses.clause: A KMP may not deal in Company Securities on considerations of a short-term nature or engage in hedging or short-sale transactions with respect to Company Securities.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Independently reinforces the derivatives ban and would separately catch the written call leg of a collar as akin to a short-sale transaction.

bespoke_clauses.clause: KMP are prohibited from entering into margin lending or similar arrangements in respect to Company Securities they hold or in which they have a Relevant Interest without first obtaining prior clearance from the appropriate Approving Officer.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: The loan leg of a funded structure would likely qualify as a 'similar arrangement' to margin lending and could be cleared with 10 Business Days' notice and document review, but this only addresses the financing leg; the derivative legs remain absolutely banned by clause 6.3, so the funded collar as a whole cannot proceed for a KMP.

bespoke_clauses.clause: the Approving Officer does not believe that there are appropriate arrangements in place between the KMP and the margin lender or financier to enable the KMP to comply with the terms of this Policy ... including clause 6.1 if there is any Dealing in any Company Securities by the margin lender or financier
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: A bank's enforcement sale on collateral shares is itself treated as a Dealing subject to the insider trading and Closed Period rules, so enforcement mechanics must be built into the facility documentation reviewed at clearance stage.

bespoke_clauses.clause: written requests and clearances ... are valid for a period the earlier of: (a) 5 Business Days; (b) the Business Day before the Company enters a Closed Period; and (c) the time that the KMP comes into possession of Inside Information.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Any cleared dealing (were the derivatives ban not absolute) would need to complete within a short and conditional window, relevant to timing the loan clearance and any related transfer of shares.

bespoke_clauses.clause: An Employee (who is not a KMP) may Deal in Company Securities or the Securities of a Transaction Entity if he or she does not have information that he or she knows, or ought reasonably to know, is Inside Information
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: A senior executive who does not meet the AASB 124 KMP definition faces none of the Closed Period, clearance, derivatives-ban, or hedging/short-sale restrictions, so a funded collar may be executable for that person subject only to the general insider trading rule.

summary: For KMP, a funded collar is not possible: clause 6.3 imposes an absolute, always-on ban on any financial product created over the Company's securities, independent of vesting state, Closed Periods or clearance, and clause 14.1 separately bans hedging and short-sale transactions, with no exception in Schedule 2 or Schedule 3 that reaches a derivatives arrangement. The loan leg alone (a margin loan or 'similar arrangement') can be cleared by the Approving Officer with at least 10 Business Days' notice and review of the financing documents, including confirmation that the lender's own dealing (e.g. an enforcement sale) will comply with the Policy, but that clearance is useless without the derivative legs, which remain banned. For an Employee who is not KMP under AASB 124, none of these restrictions apply: only the general Inside Information prohibition is relevant, so a funded collar could in principle be structured for a senior but non-KMP executive, subject to normal insider-trading diligence and timing around the Company's Closed Periods (which apply only to KMP in any event).
